page.overview:
What is The Stitchwraith?

is an animatronic endoskeleton who was brought to life with "agony" by Dr. Phineas Taggart. He contains the soul of Jake, Andrew, and William Afton. He appears in all the Stitchwraith Stingers epilogues of the Fazbear Frights books and as an easter egg in Five Nights at Freddy's: Into the Pit.

The Stitchwraith is a mysterious figure wearing a long and voluminous wool hooded trench coat that originally belonged to Phineas. Its body is a broken, ruptured man-sized endoskeleton of unknown origin. The Stitchwraith's head is that of the Real Jake Doll, being placed on top of the endoskeleton’s head. He has a bulky, round white face with features drawn onto the curved surface with thick black marker. The doll has sunken black eyes, one of which is blackened to resemble a black eye the "real Jake" got by standing up to a bully. It has a mouth with a missing tooth and something stuck between the remaining front teeth, which is meant to be a popcorn kernel. Larson mistakes the pizza stains around the mouth for blood stains. The last component of the Stitchwraith is Fetch’s large plastic-encased battery pack, which is placed in a port in the endoskeleton’s chest. His battery pack pulses bright red when first activated, and the Stitchwraith can use the battery back to make his hand can glow red with heat.

The Stitchwraith is often dismissed as an urban legend. He is often seen in garbage dumps, scavenging them for personal intentions. It's been caught on picture dragging a mannequin out of a dumpster in one instance. There are also five murders associated with the Stitchwraith, in which the victims' bodies all appeared withered, with "eyes that bled black down the sides of the face."

It is later seen by a homeless man, Grim, pulling animatronic parts from the destroyed Plushtrap Chaser into a bag, after the events of Out of Stock.
